subject: Guard
text: If you do not talk to every one on the barge, the Guard tells you to halt and stay away, but after talking to every one on the barge, the Guard invites you to enter because the Queen expects you.

evidence.quote:
(If you do not talk to every one on the barge)
Guard: Halt! Stay away from here.

(After talking to every one on the barge)
Guard: Please enter the Queen expects you!

subject: Cleopatra
text: Cleopatra asks you to bring her a large pepperoni pizza, promising she will take you to the tetrad if you bring it to her.

evidence.quote:
Cleopatra Hmmmmmmm... I may be able to help you. I know of this tetrad and I 
could take you to it for a price. Do you like pizza? I love pizza. It's my 
favorite! I ordered a large pepperoni and it has taken way too long... It's 
been 3 days already! Why must they keep their Queen waiting? It makes me 
soooooo angry!! Bring me my pizza and I will take you to the tetrad and hold 
the anchovies, OK?

subject: Guard
text: North of the barge, a guard tells you to cross the boarder here to find the pizza.

evidence.quote:
(North of the barge)
Guard: Going for pizza, huh? Cross the boarder here and you'll find it.

subject: cave
text: After passing through cave, the game saves your progress.

evidence.quote:
(After passing through cave) 
Wow! You've done it! Now saving refrain from turning power off or resetting!! 
Good luck!

subject: Rent-A-Camel
text: East of the exit, a guy suggests trying Rent-A-Camel for a smooth ride to find pizza.

evidence.quote:
(East of the exit)
Guy: Hey buddy, where ya headin'?
*You tell the story... Blah blah seeking pizza blah traveling blah blah...
Guy: Pizza? That's the hot cheesy pie from Rome, right? Try Rent-A-Camel for a 
smooth ride.

subject: pizza
text: A delivery guy on a camel route hands over a large pizza with extra pepperoni.

evidence.quote:
Guy: Hey! You know the way to the Nile? I've got a special delivery. A large 
pizza with extra pepperoni for our best customers.
*You tell the story... Blah blah seeking pizza blah Cleopatra blah blah...
Guy: OK, I'll leave it up to you. Thanks a lot pal!
You've got the pizza.

subject: Cleopatra
text: After you hand over the pizza, Cleopatra sails the barge across the Nile and directs you to a great pyramid to the south.

evidence.quote:
Woman: You've returned! And you have the pizza! Quick give it to me before it 
cools!
*You hand her the pizza....Cleopatra: Let me take you to the tetrad, OK?
(The barge sails across the Nile.)
Cleopatra: To the south, you'll find a great pyramid. The tetrad is rumored to 
be within its walls. Bravely face the danger of the pyramid and you'll reach 
the tetrad. Good luck on your journey!

subject: bronze dagger
text: If you don't have the bronze dagger, Cleopatra gives you her bronze dagger before you face the great pyramid.

evidence.quote:
(If you don't have the bronze dagger)
Cleopatra: To the south, you'll find a great pyramid. The tetrad is rumored to 
be within its walls. Bravely face the danger of the pyramid and you'll reach 
the tetrad. I will trade you for my bronze dagger.
You've got a dagger!

subject: pyramid
text: When entering and exiting the pyramid, a man notes that you need something special to cross the pyramids magic field.

evidence.quote:
(Enter then exit the pyramid)
Man: You need something special to cross the pyramids magic field.

subject: mad magician
text: North of the pyramid, a man mentions there is a mad magician in a field beyond the reeds to the north.

evidence.quote:
(North of the pyramid)
Man: There's a mad magician in a field beyond the reeds to the north! I was up 
there. He was driving me bananas!

subject: Psychic Shock Wave
text: At the end of the maze, a monkey grants you the Psychic Shock Wave to break barriers and strike down enemies.

evidence.quote:
(At the end of the maze)
(There is a mountain. A monkey appears on the mountain then jumps down to the 
ground.)...Monkey: Listen well. There is a special ability that I must give to you. It is 
the power of the mind. You've got the Psychic Shock Wave.
Monkey: With this force, you will be able to break barriers and strike down 
your enemies. Now, begone with you.

subject: pyramid
text: Outside the pyramid, a snake says it snaked inside once and was changed by a very catchy tune.

evidence.quote:
(Outside the pyramid)
Snake: Psst... Psst... Let me tell you about the pyramid. I snaked into there 
once and was changed by a very catchy tune.

subject: pyramid
text: At the end of the pyramid, the game saves your progress.

evidence.quote:
(At the end of the pyramid)
Wow! You've done it! Now saving refrain from turning off or resetting!! Good 
luck!

subject: Tetrad
text: Going north at the end of the pyramid awards a Tetrad and increases your life level.

evidence.quote:
(Go north)
You've got a Tetrad! Your life level increased!

subject: Oxford World Wonders
text: Reciting the magic words Paa Paa Paa Oom Maw Maw into the Oxford World Wonders transports Mike to Chapter 4 at 221B Baker Street in London.

evidence.quote:
*You decide to use the
*Oxford World Wonders again.
*You turn to the next page
*and say the magic words...

Paa Paa Paa Oom Maw Maw...(The screen shows an open book.) 
Left Page: ............... You slip to another time and space...
Right Page: Chapter 4

(Mike appears in a village.) 
*You appear...
Mike: Huh? Where am I? Oh! Here's an address... 221B Baker Street... London!

subject: Sherlock Holmes
text: Sherlock Holmes asks Mike to meet him at the museum at midnight to catch Zoda-X stealing a curious stone.

evidence.quote:
Sherlock Holmes: Ah... Good evening. Allow me to introduce myself... The name 
is Holmes....In fact, I have 
concluded that a robbery will occur in the museum tonight. A rascal by the name 
of Zoda-X intends to steal a most curious stone....Sherlock Holmes: Oh? Well then you shall help me catch him red-handed. Meet me 
at the museum at the stroke of midnight. And... Don't be late!

subject: Cop
text: South of the police station, a cop detains Mike for suspiciously heading to the museum late at night.

evidence.quote:
(South of the police station)
Dog: Woof! Bow bow! Woof woof!

Cop: A little late to be going to the museum, isn't it? Hmm... Suspicious. Come 
with me!

subject: Zoda-X
text: At the museum, Zoda-X escapes with the tetrad, and Sherlock Holmes tells Mike to give chase.

evidence.quote:
(At the museum)
Sherlock Holmes: Aha! Just in time, Wats... Er... Mike. Come, I will show you 
the stone.
(The screen changes and shows the tetrad on a podium)
*A tetrad!
*Quickly, you reach for it
* But, suddenly...
(Zoda appears on the right side of the screen)
Zoda-X: Ha! Ha! I've got the tetrad now, Mike!...*Zoda-X has escaped with
*the tetrad!
(The scene changes, showing Sherlock Holmes)
Sherlock Holmes: The game's afoot Mike! You give chase and I will cut him off!

subject: Sherlock Holmes
text: North of the sewer exit, Sherlock Holmes deduces from Zoda-X that there must also be a Zoda-Y and Z.

evidence.quote:
(Exit sewers then go north)
(The scene changes showing Sherlock Holmes)
Sherlock Holmes: Well done Mike! You are a very clever sleuth! Do you know of 
this stone?...Sherlock Holmes: Of course! From Zoda-X, I deuce that there must be a Zoda-Y 
and Z! Hurry Mike! You are not alone in the chase for the Tetrads! Make haste!

subject: cactus
text: A man advises that approaching a cactus from the south prevents getting pricked by needles.

evidence.quote:
Man #4: Howdy pardner. When you walk up to a cactus, approach it from the 
south. That way you won't get pricked by the needles.

subject: buried mine
text: A man in the store house states that a tetrad is in a mine buried by a landslide and can be reached by blasting in the right place.

evidence.quote:
(Store house)
Man: Howdy! Looks like you've been thru a lot! What brings you to these parts?
*You tell the story...
Mike: Blah blah seeking Tetrads blah traveling blah blah...
Man: Hmm... You know I seen to recall a strange rock like your tet tot rad. It 
is in the mine that has since been buried by a landslide. If you blast in the 
right place, you'll open the way to your tet tod rad.

subject: Red Eye Ginger Ale
text: At the Silver Dollar Saloon, you can drink a shot of sarsaparilla and a shot of Red Eye Ginger Ale.

evidence.quote:
Bartender: Howdy pardner! Welcome to the Silver Dollar Saloon! Have a shot of 
sarsaparilla.
*You drink the shot... Mmmmmm... Delicious!

Man #2: Howdy pardner.

Man #3: Have a shot of my Red Eye Ginger Ale.
*You drink the shot...
(The screen flashes)
Mmmmmm... Dynamite!

subject: cactus dance
text: If you choose yes, the piano player details the cactus dance: face the cactus, take 2 steps to the left and 3 steps to the right, turn left again, keep walking until you hit the wall, and blast the wall to enter the lost mine.

evidence.quote:
(If you choose yes)
Piano player: Eureka! I've done it. I've hit pay dirt. Rich is what I am and 
the town I will alert. There's gold in them thar hills. And it's brought me 
many thrills. Now it's gold that you can earn. But there's a step you must 
learn... It's the... Cactus dance, do the cactus dance. Everybody in the 
desert, do the cactus dance. Steep light and don't you stick. Seek a special 
cactus and make it quick. Face the cactus if you might. Then take 2 steps to 
the left and 3 steps to the right. Turn left again. OK, that's all. Then keep 
on walkin' 'til you hit the wall. Cactus dance, do the cactus dance. Shake up 
the shack with the cactus dance. The lost mine is yours if you want that too, 
just blast the wall and you'll get thru.
